My FTP test came back at 260 watts last night.
Current time: Monday, July 6th, 1998 - 09:00 (UTC) / 1998-07-06 09:00 UTC
Great result—your FTP is now **260 W**, up **10 W (4%)** from 250 W. I’ve updated your profile and will base future power targets on 260 W; at your profile weight of 70 kg, that’s **3.71 W/kg**.

Given that, how should Thursday's intervals change?
Current time: Monday, July 6th, 1998 - 09:00 (UTC) / 1998-07-06 09:00 UTC

Keep Thursday’s **interval structure and %FTP targets unchanged**; with FTP updated from 250 to 260 W, the absolute targets should rise by **4%** automatically.

Your **Form is +7**, resting HR is at baseline, and sleep was solid, so the new targets are reasonable if your legs have recovered from the test. If they still feel heavy Thursday, use the **bottom of each prescribed %FTP range** rather than shortening the session.

I don’t see a Thursday workout on your calendar—paste the interval structure if you want me to adjust it precisely.

And remind me what my current weekly Load target is.
Current time: Monday, July 6th, 1998 - 09:00 (UTC) / 1998-07-06 09:00 UTC
You don’t currently have a saved **weekly Load target**—there’s no active training plan or past note recording one. If you had a number in mind, tell me and I can save it.
